### IBM — AI Software Developer (Toronto, ON | June 2023 – Present)

#### Conversational AI Platform (Forward-Deployed Technical Lead)
- Owned customer outcomes from kickoff through production go-live in 4.5 months, embedding on-site with client stakeholders as technical lead for architecture, hosting, infrastructure, and production rollout.
- Turned ambiguous operational needs into clear technical specs and product decisions by running requirements discovery directly with non-technical operations teams and providing hands-on technical guidance.
- Built and shipped production LLM-powered features using the OpenAI Agents SDK, enabling field staff to log inspections and raise alerts conversationally and managers to query live KPIs and status in natural language.
- Delivered the full-stack product end to end (database to UI) in TypeScript, React, Python (FastAPI), and Microsoft SQL Server as containerized microservices with REST APIs on Microsoft Azure.
- Sustained high shipping velocity and code quality using an AI-assisted SDLC (Claude Code, Codex) paired with automated AI code review on every pull request in CI/CD.

#### Multi-Agent Automation / Digital Worker Platform
- Cut a client's SDLC modernization timeline by 67% (from a projected 12 months to 4 months) by deploying specialized AI agents across each stage of the software development lifecycle.
- Built an end-to-end agentic coding pipeline where AI agents pick up and resolve backlog tickets, write technical documentation, generate UI renders, and perform automated pull request reviews (GitHub Copilot review bot + custom review agents).
- Architected scalable, asynchronous, event-driven microservices (JobManager API, workers, agents, aggregator) on Azure Queue Storage, Azure Blob Storage, and MongoDB.
- Built oversight, trust, and control into high-stakes automated workflows via a Python multi-agent execution service pairing LLM reasoning with deterministic validation, guardrails, and structured outputs, orchestrated by a .NET 8 (C#) service handling durable job lifecycles, retries, and idempotency.
- Cut developer onboarding time to a first working agent from ~1 week to 1 day by generating typed C# and Python SDKs from OpenAPI specifications alongside a reusable worker template; accelerated root-cause diagnosis with end-to-end OpenTelemetry distributed tracing.

#### Voice-Enabled Conversational AI Assistant (0-to-1 on MCP)
- Took a voice-enabled conversational LLM agent for enterprise asset management workflows from 0-to-1 prototype on an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server to full production deployment, working directly with stakeholders throughout rollout and helping win an enterprise implementation contract.
- Improved user experience scores by 26% (+0.8 out of 5) by building and shipping the full-stack application in React, TypeScript, FastAPI, Python, and PostgreSQL.
- Improved service resilience and horizontal scalability by containerizing Python services with Docker and deploying to Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) with Terraform infrastructure as code.

#### Financial Services Compliance (KYC/AML) Reporting Agent
- Reduced KYC/AML compliance report turnaround in a regulated financial-services workflow by 90% (from 45 days down to 5 days) by building a custom AI reasoning agent that queries enterprise compliance systems and internal legacy relational databases, synthesizes client records, and drafts compliance reports.
- Modernized legacy compliance data flows by engineering an ETL pipeline in Go, nginx, SQL, and MongoDB that extracts and transforms relational data and loads LLM-generated compliance documents into MongoDB.

## Technical Projects & ML Research

### Healthcare AI Voice Agent (2024)
- Built a custom Twilio-connected AI voice agent automating patient intake for healthcare providers, collecting demographics, insurance details, and appointment preferences through natural conversation integrated with external validation APIs.
- **Stack:** Python, FastAPI, Twilio, Voice AI, External REST APIs.

### AiRM Robotic Arm — Reinforcement Learning & Computer Vision (2023)
- Implemented the Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) reinforcement learning algorithm in PyTorch with MuJoCo physics simulation and OpenAI Gymnasium to control an 8-motor, 7-DOF Kinova Gen3 robotic arm.
- Transferred the learned policy to a physical robotic arm with OpenCV computer vision for real-time object detection, reach, fetch, and pick-and-place sorting, achieving 90% task accuracy.
- **Demo:** https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WiJtKO3sOtU
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/techstartucalgary/roboticarm
- **Stack:** Python, PyTorch, Reinforcement Learning (DDPG), MuJoCo, OpenAI Gymnasium, OpenCV.

### Gaitonomics / Procidensa — Healthcare ML Hackathon Winner (2022)
- Won 1st place ($5,000) in Healthcare Systems at the Innovation4Health Hackathon, leading a cross-functional team of 3 engineers and 2 healthcare clinicians from concept to live-demonstrated prototype.
- Built a supervised KNN machine learning model analyzing 20+ hours of gait data to flag abnormal walking patterns linked to fall risk and neurological disease, paired with a real-time data dashboard API validated across 20+ live participants.
- **Deck:** https://www.canva.com/design/DAFAPDSQuaA/SWkz9_ZF8LleJCMrH7nb2A/view
- **Stack:** Python, Next.js, React, Node.js, Docker, AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, TensorFlow, Keras, MongoDB.

### WhereTo? (2022)

### Self-Checkout System Backend (2021)
